items.title: Actual PBPS: one probability kernel and its real-L2 operator

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS explicitly completes same-witness, representative and AE-order details of the fixed-time phase process. This is not all of Proposition A.1 or Definition D.2.
source.anchor: Appendix A.1 fixed-time phase invariance and Definition D.2 formula (D.4); selected realization component

items.statement: Assume the six displayed analytic hypotheses. Put V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), pi_y=volume.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E), nu_y=pi_y times gamma and P=Exp(1)^N. Use the literal fixed-reference PBPS flow with center c=y-eta grad V(r), position c+cos(t)(x-c)+sqrt(eta)sin(t)p and momentum -sin(t)(x-c)/sqrt(eta)+cos(t)p. The bounce reflects momentum in grad V(x)-grad V(r), with the identity for a zero normal; its rate is sqrt(eta) max(0,<p,grad V(x)-grad V(r)>). Independent exponential thresholds determine integrated-hazard waiting times, post-bounce records and between-jump interpolation. The existing raw initial-state fallback outside covered intervals is retained, not introduced anew. There is one global jointly measurable actual process Z with the every-raw-input arc/fallback rules and parameterwise clock-AE zero-time initialization. Its endpoint sends nu_y times P to nu_y; bounded signed flip duality and jointly measurable bounded-Borel clock expectations retain their integrability and uniform bounds. A single joint-index probability kernel Kphase has every fiber exactly map(Z(y,r,z,t))P. For every fixed y,r,t the state-kernel z -> Kphase(((y,r),z),t) preserves nu_y as an exact measure equality. For each y,r the SAME continuous real-linear L2(nu_y) family A_t satisfies A_0=I, ||A_t||<=1 and A_t f -> f at zero for every f. Every canonical L2 representative f-sharp is integrable on almost every kernel fiber, and (A_t f)-sharp(z)=integral f-sharp(z') Kphase(((y,r),z),t)(dz') for nu_y-almost every z. A_t preserves AE nonnegativity and fixes every real constant class, whose L2 membership is produced. All earlier arbitrary-MemLp clock representation and square-integral bounds remain. The momentum flip J is an involutive isometry and A_t*=J A_t J. The position pullback B is isometric; M=B* equals Gaussian integration for arbitrary MemLp representatives, MB=I, JB=B, MJ=M. Kpos_t=M A_t B remains a self-adjoint contraction with Kpos_0=I and its Gaussian-outer/clock-inner representative, including both nested AE integrability obligations. This identifies a phase probability kernel and its existing operator, not a restart law or a position probability kernel.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with canonical volume; dimension zero is allowed.
V is C2; alpha,beta are nonnegative with 0<alpha<=beta, and alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for all x,v. Also eta>0 and beta eta<=1.
Process, Gibbs probability, kernel, invariance, L2 realization, integrability, positivity and constants are conclusions, not supplied assumptions.

Each AE assertion is for fixed parameters/time/observable. Lp coercion chooses a strongly measurable representative of an AE class. Positivity preserves AE nonnegativity, not a Hilbert quadratic form.
